source: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API, fetched for this bounding box
generated_note: One-time build; see tools/build_basemap.py. Dashboard makes no runtime network calls.

raster.note: Styled color rendering of real OpenStreetMap data (coastline, water, rivers, roads, land cover, built-up areas) for the tower bounding box, rendered once offline by tools/build_basemap_raster.py. Colors and line widths are styling only. Equirectangular: pixel x/y map linearly to longitude/latitude.
